title: Autonomous Vehicle Simulation
description: Built an end-to-end autonomous driving pipeline using PyTorch and the CARLA simulator. Trained a deep autoencoder on ~8,000 frames from Cityscapes and CARLA datasets, achieving sub-50ms inference latency for real-time decision-making. Applied behavioral cloning via CNN-based models to predict steering and throttle control signals with high precision.

title: InstaResume — AI Resume Generator
description: Engineered a real-time resume builder with dynamic form handling using React Hook Form and debounced state updates for smooth live preview rendering. Integrated Google Gemini AI for keyword-optimized resume generation; implemented client-side PDF export via @react-pdf/renderer. Delivered responsive resume templates with live preview and real-time editing capabilities.

title: BlogSpace — Full-Stack Blog Platform
description: Implemented RESTful APIs using MVC architecture with modular routes, controllers, models, and middleware layers. Secured the application with JWT-based authentication and protected CRUD operations via authorization middleware and PostgreSQL-backed user management. Deployed on Render with PostgreSQL integration and a responsive Bootstrap-based frontend UI.
